notes: Health Care pharma focused on brain disorders. R&D partnerships (External Innovation Unit, Contera, Iambic, Michael J. Fox Foundation grants received by Lundbeck) are licensing or research collaborations and were not counted for Community or Entrepreneurship. The LMIC product donations and the Equity-based Tiered Pricing framework could arguably support Cross-cultural customer access. They were kept under Community only to avoid double counting, and the level was held at 2 when torn. The report also describes a Neurodiversity commitment that adapts working conditions, and a Migraine-Friendly Workplace certification, as further internal practices. Workforce gender and age statistics are demographics only. The 2025 inclusion score target (8.5) was missed (8.2). In 2025 the company moved to a partner-led model in 27 countries (602 employees impacted) and exited Pakistan (22 employees). The Sustainability Strategy is being updated, with a new strategy due in 2026. Older legal matters (EU competition fine from 2013, US DOJ CID, Humana kickback complaint) do not involve rights findings.
